method.source_change_disposition: The original lane established the forum-mini behavior and public case bindings. The first amendment implements the observed current RecentThreads placeholder contract. The second implements the sealed anonymous read-only default FrontForum, ForumStart, category, thread, thread-post, and RecentPosts first-page contracts. The review amendment moves Site:View and Page:View filtering before count, order, and limit work; excludes hidden ForumStart groups and their categories in the structure queries used by the normal index; completes the observed category pager; preserves the complete thread/posts response envelope; and serves exact read-only routes without granting the observed remote jsInclude values loader authority. The first Comments amendment adds the saved-page shell and exact anonymous page-to-discussion forward and reverse ten-root read model. The attribute amendment adds the evidenced title, hide, forwards, and reverse source forms and keeps invalid or unobserved saved heads query-free. The FrontForum scalar amendment selects existing categories through one permission-filtered global order, then applies the observed offset and limit while keeping per-item category identity; body-bearing custom formats remain typed-owner residuals. Mutations, hideForm, non-anonymous actors, and browser lifecycle remain explicit gaps.
